answer: The atlas schedule is applied in dawn and comet publishes each instalment. A payout is split and hence 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 514 identities would post 1569 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
